  - UI/entry point integration to invoke the service and reflect current torch state.
  - Permission handling/utilities and error/reporting hooks.
- Primary design decisions:
  - Platform-specific implementations behind a common interface.
  - Graceful handling when torch is unavailable or in use by camera.
  - Maintain internal state to avoid redundant calls; subscribe to system callbacks (Android TorchCallback) to sync state.
  - Permission strategy: request only when needed; provide rationale prompts; fail closed without crashing.
  - Lifecycle management: auto-release on app background/termination; handle interruptions (incoming calls, camera sessions).
- Risks:
  - Device lacks flashlight or multi-camera mapping failures.
  - Permission denials and OEM-specific behavior.
  - Conflicts with active camera sessions; concurrent access errors.
  - OS changes (Android 13+ permission nuances; iOS torch behavior) and background restrictions.
